metrics.label: Spotify monthly listeners
metrics.note: Current monthly listeners. Verified 28 Aug 2026 on Spotify's own artist page (55,701,680, #49 in the world), which agreed with kworb exactly. Monitor-only — no siteTargets — because the site publishes the all-time PEAK (spotify-peak-listeners), not the current figure. Do not conflate the two: the peak is 60.13M and cannot fall. CROSS-CHECKED 4 Sep 2026: kworb read 52,813,789, a 5.2% FALL, and the same figure Spotify's own page showed that day (recorded in app/data/africasBiggest.ts). That correctly trips this metric — relativeDrift is absolute, so a fall alerts exactly like a rise — and the weekly issue for it is the alarm working, not a stale config. The baseline is deliberately NOT bumped to the kworb reading: it records the last value read at the PRIMARY source by a human, and overwriting that with an automated pull would both downgrade its provenance and silence the alert someone is meant to act on. Bump it when you next read Spotify's own page. Worth a thought while you are here: a current-listeners figure swings far more than 3% across a release cycle, so this threshold will keep firing on ordinary decline — raise it if the weekly issue stops being read.

metrics.note: Year-to-date Spotify streams, kept as a LEDGER: a checkpoint (the total through a date) plus each later day's streams under the date kworb's page is stamped with. Published = checkpoint + every daily to the group's common day — the newest day all five ledgers cover without a hole — and the checkpoint rolls forward on each write; all five rows or none; a hold on any member holds all. Never the change in kworb's cumulative total (kworb absorbs catalogue it had not tracked: Tems' total rose 138M between 27 Aug and 9 Sep 2026 while her days summed to 74M), and never dailies keyed by the bot's run date (that added Burna Boy's 27 Aug, 29 Aug and 2 Sep twice and never added 28 Aug, 31 Aug or 9 Sep; net small — the board's false Burna-over-Wizkid reading of 11 Sep was several small things adding up, see docs/sourcing/STREAMS-2026-ANCHOR.md). No relative jump guard: dailyMax gates each day on the way in, and after a hold a week's worth is a legitimate move. ANCHOR: the fan tracker @WITTIEWIZ's '2026 so far' post of 10 Sep 2026 11:31 UTC (x.com/WITTIEWIZ/status/2098011367378735458), through kworb's pages stamped 2026/09/09 (Tems: through her 09/08 page — kworb published no 09/09 page for her, and neither the tracker nor this ledger has that day). Summed once per kworb day, kworb's own dailies and the tracker's count agree within a few million over the fortnight before. Re-anchor from the tracker's next 'so far' post whenever the two drift by more than a day's streams, and whenever a gap is reported. The baseline is always the checkpoint's value; re-anchoring means moving both together. PLACES ARE CALLED: the board ranks the rows by value and names the leader — Paul's decision of 17 Sep 2026, when the trackers had Burna Boy past Wizkid and Tems by 2.7M and the site was still marking the three joint. The joint mark (tieWithin, option (b) of 12 Sep) is retired; the code path stays for a future decision, and with no tieWithin on any member tiedRows() marks nothing. THIS ARTIST: 09/10 daily is the exact figure on her page (stamped 09/10 on 12 Sep). SKIPPED STAMPS: when kworb's next page for this artist skips a day, the skipped day's streams are derived from the page's own totals (fillSkippedDays), gated to 0.5–1.5× the two stamped dailies around it, and listed as derived in the run summary; a gap that fails the gate is left as a hole for a hand.
